caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular patchwork-style composition made up of sixteen smaller rectangular and square sections, each containing individual motifs. The background colors of these sections range from dark brown and black to muted reds and greens. Several panels feature symmetrical floral arrangements with pink, red, white, and blue flowers and green leaves. One panel shows two stylized birds perched on branches, another presents a rooster or large bird, and a panel next to them depicts two human figures, one in a blue outfit and another in reddish-brown, standing beside a basket of red objects. Additional panels contain singular large flowers or floral bouquets in vases. The lower row of panels includes a depiction of two ducks or birds on a striped background, a central stylized floral form, and an image of a gray animal resembling a dog or lamb on another striped background. The bottom right panel features a blue and white cat sitting upright. Colors throughout the composition include predominately earthy tones with accents of pink, red, blue, white, and yellow. The entire patchwork is bordered by a narrow dark edge, and the inner arrangement is divided by borders of varying widths and colors.
title: Caswell Carpet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
